'''Thomas Sturgill''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[January 2000 Knoxville tournament]] on 16 January 2000, according to Jon Tomayko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d180">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-knoxville-tn-1-16-00d180/ knoxville-tn-1-16-00], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 16 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-knoxville-tn-1-16-00d180/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
